context: A boss and his manager review market data
purpose: Teach: 返答/内訳/値上がり/倍増/消耗/受給/心得/規律

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 競合の値上がり、利益への影響、内訳を出せ。
lines.en: Competitor price increases. Break down the profit impact and specifics.
lines.style: Direct, clipped delivery. No warmth. Expects immediate comprehension and action. Sharp consonants on the key terms—crisp attack on each demand.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。コスト消耗が倍増する想定です。
lines.en: Yes. We're projecting our costs to double under these conditions.
lines.style: Measured, professional. Steady eye contact. Delivers the bad news plainly without hedging—respectful of the boss's time and intelligence. Even breath, no apology in the tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 役員会への返答、急ぐぞ。
lines.en: Get that ready for the board meeting. Now.
lines.style: Clipped urgency. Each word lands. Low register, quiet but absolute—no room for negotiation. The kind of command that makes you move before you think.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 承知。労務受給バランスも、規律を保ちつつ、見直します。
lines.en: Understood. I'll review the labor allocation too—maintaining standards while we adjust.
lines.style: Calm, capable. Speaking slightly faster to show readiness and efficiency without rushing. Reassuring in its steadiness—promising both speed and thoroughness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: これまでの心得、忘れるな。
lines.en: Don't lose sight of what we've built here.
lines.style: Weighted, almost paternal. Slows slightly on the main clause. Quiet conviction—not lecturing, but reminding. The kind of closing statement that lands because it's sparse.
